env_allowlist.HOME: runner home used only to address the hash-verified .elan/bin/lake launcher

recipes.network_enforcement: Every Lean replay subprocess runs inside bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, and only a fresh temporary output directory writable; the checker invokes no update, build, clone, fetch, or network operation.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line UTF-8 summary bound by validation-receipt.json output_evidence.stdout_semantic_sha256

recipes.expected_output_policy: Six exact summary lines must report three provisional narrow passes and three fail-closed source, assurance, or release boundaries.
recipes.scope_boundary: Trust-zero, network-isolated worker replay of the exact frozen proposition and its local body, plus a separately written same-worker reconstruction that imports neither Proof nor ObligationTree. It validates that the defective frozen root kernel-closes and that the defect is real; it supplies no positive source-CKN proof, accepted obligation closure, release hermeticity, or distinct-runner independence.

status_boundary: A passing recipe self-tests only a truthful blocked validation packet. The source identity gate fails, so the recipe cannot promote the proof dependency, establish M0/E0/E1, close the intended CKN root, or establish AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release, or master acceptance.
